description: Use this when the person wants a photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) made from photos they attached, direct image links, or a public iCloud Shared Album link. Designs a draft book from the photos in the supplied order; nothing is ordered or charged. Photos the person attached in this chat go in attachments, which ChatGPT fills in; never pass local file paths. Otherwise provide direct CDN image URLs or uploadIds from POST /api/connector/photos in photos (you can choose the best photos yourself and send only those, in order; HEIC and rotated phone photos are accepted), or a public iCloud Shared Album link as sharedAlbumUrl (https://www.icloud.com/sharedalbum/#TOKEN). A book needs at least 24 pages to be printed, so a handful of photos gives a book that can be viewed but not yet ordered. Returns a preview and a private link to save the book by email. No account setup. Allow up to 180 seconds for imports.

attachments.description: Photos the person attached in this chat. ChatGPT supplies the file objects; never invent them.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the person writes in, such as nl or en.

photos.description: Public https image URLs on a known CDN, or uploadIds. Not for chat attachments or local paths.

sharedAlbumUrl.description: Public iCloud Shared Album link, used instead of photos.

name: create_book

bookToken.description: Private token for get_book. Keep it private.

claimUrl.description: Private link where the person saves the book with their email, then edits and orders it.

language.description: The chat's language, as passed in.

orderable.description: Whether the book can be printed as it is.

status.description: "ready", or "processing_or_interrupted" while the same request is still running.

unavailableReason.description: Why it cannot be printed yet, such as too few pages.

title: Make a photo book
